name: Hexing Electrical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hexing Electrical Co.,Ltd. engages in smart power distribution, smart water management, and digital energy-related businesses in China and internationally. The company offers smart metering, data acquisition and communication, power distribution equipment, new energy, software and platforms, water treatment, and marine propulsion products. It also provides smart energy metering, energy management systems, C and I power distribution, data centers, billing and trading platform, treatment of distribution transformer area, feder automation, medium-voltage microgrid, renewable energy station, rural distribution area energy storage, solar-storage-charging integrated energy storage, industrial park…
